scope: Independent code reading plus rerun of existing author software tests; not new calibration
observations: Compact80-position masks are decoded before count summation
Ledger hash chain and round-robin prefix identity are checked before resume
A local run lock prevents concurrent ledger writers
The numerical cohort and source/protocol byte identities are enforced on append
Completed chunks charge parent process CPU plus waited-worker/descendant CPU, including compiler startup
The CPU budget is a soft check between fixed batches; last-batch and end-charged overhead may overshoot
Unclosed sessions preserve cost uncertainty and report measured work as a lower bound
cost_limit: Charged run region, not a hard end-to-end wall-clock or total-invocation cap; freeze/status/final summary have unpriced small overhead
scientific_limit: The joint statistical false-superiority assertion does not certify all R3 adequacy/robustness/novelty or reserve requirements
